name: Deadlift
notes: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, grip the bar just outside your knees, keep your back flat, and lift by driving through your heels and extending your hips and knees together until you're standing tall.

name: Fartlek (On/Off)
notes: 8–12 × (1 min hard / 1 min easy) after 10 min warm-up

name: Chest Press
notes: Keep your feet flat, shoulder blades retracted, and control the weight through a full range of motion while pressing explosively and lowering slowly.

name: Weighted Burpees
notes: Hold a pair of dumbbells, drop into a push-up position with the weights, perform a push-up, jump your feet forward, then explosively jump up while pressing or lifting the dumbbells overhead.

name: DB Hip Thrust
notes: Sit with your upper back against a bench, place a dumbbell across your hips, then drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, squeezing your glutes at the top.

name: Single Arm DB Row
notes: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support, hold a dumbbell in the other hand, pull it toward your hip by squeezing your back muscles, then lower it slowly to the starting position.

name: Figure 4 Glute Stretch (Right)
notes: Seated or lying figure-4 glute stretch

name: DB Shoulder Press
notes: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height, press them overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower them back down slowly while keeping your core tight and back straight.

name: Wall Balls
notes: Catch into squat; throw from legs

name: Walking Lunges
notes: Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground, then push through your front heel to step forward into the next lunge, keeping your torso upright and core engaged.
